mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals economic stress that triggers short-term equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% monthly), declining industrial production signals recessionary pressure, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of real retail sales (RSAFS > 380,000 million dollars) indicates strong consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 380,000.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll employment growth exceeding 100,000 persons signals robust labor market conditions that drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates robust aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and CPIAUCSL increase.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 220), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing that reduces real interest rates, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220 and FEDFUNDS declines.
